---
name: Whitepaper or framework proposal
about: Propose a new architecture paper, blueprint, mapping, or major section
title: "[Proposal]: "
labels: ["proposal", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem and public value

What problem should this work address, for whom, and why does it belong in this framework?

## Proposed deliverable

Describe scope, intended audience, document type, expected status, and location.

## Architecture relevance

Which context domains, layers, capabilities, risks, or existing documents are affected?

## Evidence and authoritative sources

List primary standards, regulations, research, operational evidence, and source versions.

## Neutrality and conflicts

Identify vendor-specific dependencies, affiliations, sponsorships, or other material interests.

## Risks and exclusions

Describe likely harms, sensitive topics, jurisdictions, prohibited uses, and explicit non-goals.

## Contributors and reviewers

Name willing authors and the architecture, policy, security, privacy, accessibility, legal, or domain expertise needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The proposal defines its scope and document owner.
- [ ] Authoritative evidence supports each claim.
- [ ] The proposal addresses security, privacy, accessibility, and affected-party implications.
- [ ] The proposal makes no claims of certification or product endorsement.
